verdict.rationale: Community evidence explicitly documents that Unreal charges a 5% royalty on gross revenue after the first $1M (or $3,000/quarter) — this is the opposite of 'no royalties, keep what you earn.' No evidence pack item supports a royalty-free/no-fee licensing model; instead multiple citations (comm-1, comm-9, comm-13, comm-2) confirm a royalty-based commercial license.
